metadata.description: Cross-modal pairs discovered via LaTeX \ref{} co-citation. v2: (F1) section-level replaced by char-distance proximity (≤300 chars); (F2) caption prefix-stripped before Jaccard + numeric double-gate; (F3) quality_score = min(conf_a,conf_b) × exp(-dist/500). v3: (G1) hub de-dup: max 3 pairs/element by quality_score; (G2) coref gate: proximity bridge must contain both \ref{} → drop if 0 refs, halve score if 1 ref.
